title: RAG assistant over support tickets
text: Client: saas company with a support team drowning in repeated tier-1 questions across 40k historical tickets. Built hybrid BM25 and dense retrieval in Qdrant with a cross-encoder reranker behind a FastAPI service, and an evaluation set of 300 real questions. Result: deflected 23% of tier-1 tickets in the first month. Answer faithfulness was checked weekly against the evaluation set.

title: Churn prediction for a subscription box company
text: Client: ecommerce company with rising churn with no way to target retention offers. Compared logistic regression, random forest and gradient boosting with stratified 5-fold cross-validation and tuned the threshold for recall. Result: reached 0.71 PR-AUC versus 0.52 for the previous rules. Delivered a model card and a monthly retraining script.

title: Demand forecasting for a grocery chain
text: Client: retail company with stock-outs and waste across 900 SKUs in 14 stores. Benchmarked Prophet against LightGBM with lag and holiday features. Result: cut weighted MAPE from 31% to 22%. Forecasts ran as a nightly job writing to the client's warehouse.

title: Invoice field extraction from scanned PDFs
text: Client: accounting company with an accounts team typing 2,000 supplier invoices a month by hand. Combined Tesseract OCR with a fine-tuned LayoutLM model and a review queue for low-confidence fields. Result: reached 94% field-level accuracy on 500 labelled invoices. The model runs on CPU and exports to ONNX.

title: Defect detection on a production line
text: Client: manufacturing company with manual inspection missing surface defects on metal parts. Organised labelling of 6,000 images and trained a YOLO detector deployed on an edge GPU. Result: reached 0.88 mAP at IoU 0.5. False alarms were reviewed with line operators each week.

title: LLM pipeline for contract clause extraction
text: Client: legal company with lawyers reading hundreds of supplier contracts for renewal and liability clauses. Built a structured-output LLM pipeline with schema validation and a 150-contract test set. Result: matched lawyer labels on 91% of clauses. Low-confidence extractions were routed to a human reviewer.

title: Customer review sentiment and topic dashboard
text: Client: hospitality company with a hotel group with 60k reviews and no view of recurring complaints. Fine-tuned a multilingual BERT classifier and clustered complaint topics. Result: surfaced the five complaint themes behind 70% of negative reviews. Results were shown in a small dashboard for managers.

title: MLOps pipeline for model retraining
text: Client: fintech company with models retrained by hand on a data scientist's laptop. Set up MLflow tracking, Dockerised training and a GitHub Actions retraining workflow on AWS. Result: reduced retraining time from two days to three hours. Every model version is reproducible from its run id.
